originalTitle: ChatGPT and Gemini both just passed 1 billion users
summary: For the 14th time, a Google product has hit 1 billion users. content: For the 14th time, a Google product has hit 1 billion users. Google CEO Sundar Pichai posted on X that a billion people are using Gemini every month, and that Gemini is Google’s fastest-growing product ever. A billion users is a huge milestone, but Google isn’t the first AI app to hit it. OpenAI’s ChatGPT hit the mark a few weeks ago, though the company buried the announcement that “more than 1 billion people are putting ChatGPT to work” in an otherwise anodyne blog post about how people use AI. External data suggested ChatGPT crossed 1 billion users as early as this June, but OpenAI hadn’t announced anything until that post on August 6th. OpenAI spokesperson Lindsay McCallum says ChatGPT crossed 1 billion monthly users some time ago, and hit a billion a week in July. The metrics, and the growth they represent, are somewhat complicated here. OpenAI said that ChatGPT had 900 million weekly active users in February of this year, and reaching 1 billion five months later represents a significant slowdown in growth for ChatGPT, which was for years touted as the fastest-growing software ever. McCallum declined to say how many monthly users ChatGPT has. Google, meanwhile, announced in February that Gemini had 750 million monthly users, before reporting 950 million in late July on its earnings call, and Google spokesperson Alex Joseph says it reached 1 billion last week before announcing it today. (Claude appears to be growing fast, but Anthropic doesn’t disclose its user data, and estimates put its user numbers in the tens of millions.) There’s no easy way to compare weekly and monthly users, of course, but the simplest read is that ChatGPT is the larger of the platforms but Gemini may be the faster growing. These Google numbers, by the way, all appear to refer directly to the Gemini app itself, which would mean all the places Google has shoved Gemini into its other products don’t count. The Gemini that comes preinstalled on Android phones seemingly does, though, which is a huge win for Google — Gemini chief Josh Woodward posted that Gemini has more than 100 million active users on iOS, which would mean by extension that the vast majority of Gemini users are also Android users. You can see why OpenAI is so interested in building its own hardware. The AI race in general has tightened significantly this year. Anthropic’s Claude Code became a phenomenon and forced OpenAI to catch up with Codex, while Google began integrating Gemini into seemingly every surface of its products. The companies’ models have consistently leapfrogged each other, and they’re all suddenly in a race with models coming out of China. But for a long time, ChatGPT was the de facto brand for AI chatbots, and while it’s still seemingly the most popular and well known of its kind, its once commanding lead appears to have largely evaporated. The race to a billion users is over — now these companies have to race to find things for those users to do, and ways to make money in the process.
chineseTitle: ChatGPT 和 Gemini 用户数量均刚刚突破 10 亿
chineseSummary: 这是 Google 产品第 14 次突破 10 亿用户。谷歌首席执行官桑达尔·皮查伊 (Sundar Pichai) 在 X 上发帖称，每月有 10 亿人在使用 Gemini，而且 Gemini 是谷歌有史以来增长最快的产品。十亿用户是一个巨大的里程碑，但谷歌并不是第一个达到这一目标的人工智能应用程序。 OpenAI 的 ChatGPT [...]
chineseContent: 这是 Google 产品第 14 次突破 10 亿用户。谷歌首席执行官桑达尔·皮查伊 (Sundar Pichai) 在 X 上发帖称，每个月有 10 亿人在使用 Gemini，而且 Gemini 是谷歌有史以来增长最快的产品。十亿用户是一个巨大的里程碑，但谷歌并不是第一个达到这一目标的人工智能应用程序。 OpenAI 的 ChatGPT 几周前就取得了成功，尽管该公司在一篇关于人们如何使用人工智能的博客文章中隐藏了“超过 10 亿人正在使用 ChatGPT”的声明。外部数据显示，ChatGPT 最早在今年 6 月就突破了 10 亿用户，但 OpenAI 直到 8 月 6 日发布消息才宣布任何消息。 OpenAI 发言人 Lindsay McCallum 表示，ChatGPT 不久前月用户数已突破 10 亿，7 月份每周用户数突破 10 亿。这里的指标以及它们所代表的增长有些复杂。 OpenAI 表示，ChatGPT 今年 2 月的周活跃用户数为 9 亿，五个月后达到 10 亿，这对于多年来被吹捧为有史以来增长最快的软件的 ChatGPT 的增长大幅放缓。 McCallum 拒绝透露 ChatGPT 的月度用户数量。与此同时，谷歌在 2 月份宣布 Gemini 每月拥有 7.5 亿用户，然后在 7 月底的财报电话会议上报告了 9.5 亿用户，谷歌发言人亚历克斯·约瑟夫 (Alex Joseph) 表示，在今天宣布这一数字之前，上周用户数量已达到 10 亿。 （Claude 似乎增长很快，但 Anthropic 没有透露其用户数据，估计其用户数量已达数千万。）当然，没有简单的方法可以比较每周和每月的用户，但最简单的解读是 ChatGPT 是平台中规模较大的，但 Gemini 可能增长更快。顺便说一句，这些谷歌数字似乎都直接指的是
